samples.question: Inside the single dark-framed patch, use its small colored corner notch to orient the raster. The interior is a 16-row by 16-column grid of solid cells. List cells with (row+column) even in row-major order and separately list cells with (row+column) odd in row-major order; pair item k from the first list with item k from the second. For every pair write # if the two cell colors differ, and . if they match. Place the 128 results row-by-row into an 8-row by 16-column bitmap and compare it with A. Ignore the frame and every mark outside the patch. Answer A or B.
